plan.title: Single-stage RFQ upload with bad row

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the scenario.
Provide the mandatory event title so the upload flow can proceed.
Apply an RFQ template so the product sheet and upload control are available.
Upload the available CSV fixture as the closest catalog representation of the product-sheet upload.
Assert that the application reports one failed upload entry.
Assert that the failed-entry inspection control is shown.
Assert that two valid uploaded rows were retained as line items.
